articles.summary: Webb observations reveal outward-moving, element-rich gas around three early galaxies. Scientists are investigating how quickly the first galaxies changed their surroundings.
articles.title: Ancient Light Reveals Early Galactic Recycling

articles.summary: Researchers used ultrashort electrical pulses to reduce interference from moving magnetic vortices. NbN and YBCO showed different patterns as superconductivity weakened.
articles.title: Picosecond Pulses Reveal Hidden Current Limits

articles.summary: Comparisons of RNA and DNA connect a small structural difference with droplet formation and gel-like behavior, offering a testable clue to early molecular organization.
articles.title: RNA Droplets Reveal the Power of One Chemical Group
